in_hebrew.name: Bailie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bold pledge, bailiff
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bailie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Scottish Gaelic word "bail", meaning 'bail' or 'pledge'. The name Bailie was used as a title for a Scottish magistrate or bailiff, indicating a person of authority and responsibility. In the Christian context, the name Bailie can represent a commitment to upholding justice and faith.

in_latin.name: Bailie
in_latin.meaning: nomen gentilicium Anglicanum, originem habens a locutione
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bailie est originem habens a locutione, quae in Scotia et Anglia utitur. In lingua Latina, nomen gentilicium significat 'filius Bailie' vel 'descendantem a Bailie'. Ex historia, nomen Bailie est originem habens a familia nobili Scotiae, in qua familia erat origo a mediaevali familia Bailie, quae erat familia nobili Scotiae. In religione Christiana, nomen Bailie non habet directam originem a scripture vel vocabulo Hebraico/Graeco. Tamen, nomen Bailie potest significare virtutes Christianae, sicut fidelitas, caritas, et perseverantia.
